name: stop_below_anchor
label: price closes below the anchor level
description: Position closes when the price breaches a defined anchor (recent low, moving average, or breakout level).

name: thesis_signal_flips
label: the trigger signal that opened the position has now flipped against us
description: Position closes when the same signal that justified entry now reads the opposite direction.

name: volatility_collapse
label: implied volatility collapses back into normal range
description: Options position closes when IV mean-reverts, eliminating the edge the position was sized for.

name: regime_break
label: the regime backdrop the trade depended on has broken
description: Position closes when the prevailing regime classification flips away from the trade's required backdrop.
